rows.text: Net income attributable to HCA Healthcare, Inc. is expected to approximate $1.699 billion, or $7.62 per diluted share, compared to $1.653 billion, or $6.83 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2025.
Results for the second quarter of 2026 include anticipated gains on sales of facilities of $10 million, or $0.03 per diluted share.
